description: Get platform-specific options for a channel: Pinterest boards (or, with boardId, that board's sections), YouTube playlists, Tumblr blogs, Discord text channels, Threads location search. Use this when you need a platform's valid post types before creating a post for it.

boardId.description: Pinterest only: numeric board ID. Returns that board's sections ({ type: 'sections', items: [{ id, name }] }) for platformSpecific.pinterest.boardSectionId, instead of the boards. Non-numeric values return 400.

channelId.description: The channel ID to get options for.

q.description: Search term. Threads: place search for platformSpecific.threads.locationId (returns { unavailable: true } until the channel has granted location tagging).

name: get_channel_options
title: Get channel post-type options
